lines: 第一章罪子
大夏皇朝，江南道清源山下。
时至立冬，大雪封山，白雪遍地，不过此时的雪地，却不是白色的，而是被鲜血染红。
飞雪间，一少年匍匐在地，另一身材妖娆女子立于其身前，右手持剑，左手那白暂的玉手，掌心向上，在其掌心一道血焰悬浮着，血焰之间散发着五色流光。
“为什么？”
匍匐在地的那道身影，艰难的抬起头开口问道。
其身前那道身影，抬起脚一脚踩在那少年的头上。
“为什么？哈哈哈，方羽，你到现在还不明白吗？我从踏入方家开始，我就是为了复仇，要不是方玄境，我爹就不会死，十年，我卧薪尝胆十年，终于让我等到机会了，只是可惜没能将方玄境的狗头亲手摘下；不过不要紧，我亲爱的弟弟，你算是我意外的收获，没想到你居然身具五行焚天炎，有了这五行焚天炎，我就能够成为万千武者仰望的炼丹师。”
那女子看着脚下的方羽，面色狰狞的开口说道，话语之间充满了癫狂，那绝美的面庞充满了阴毒。
方羽听着秦瑶之言，身体剧烈的颤动了起来，额头青筋暴起，双目血红，丝丝血泪从其眼眶流淌而出。
“很愤怒吧，但是你一个废物，还是收敛起你这无能的愤怒吧。我倒是很好奇，你什么时候与她有瓜葛的，居然让她出面向夏皇求情。”
秦瑶看着脚下的方羽，看着那脸颊之上的血泪，不由轻笑着开口说道。
“给我搜，方羽虽然是罪子，但是陛下既然答应饶他不死，将其发配荒州，我们若是未将其带到荒州，到时候人头落地的就是我们。”
就在此时，远方传来一声厉喝。
秦瑶听到远处的厉喝声，眉头一凝，随后看着脚下的方羽。
“弟弟，姐姐走了，希望你能在十万大山活下来。”
秦瑶俯下身来，伸出手来拍了拍方羽的脸颊，一脸轻笑着开口说道。
秦瑶看着宛若烂泥一般的方羽，冷冷一笑，随后站起身来，一步跨出，再次出现已然在一丈之外，随后身形化作一道道残影，朝着远方飞奔而去。
荒州十万大山。
一破落的茅屋之内，一少年躺在那残破的木床之上，少年面色灰败，双眼无神的看着上方的房梁。
就在此时，一声轰鸣传来，随后只见那残破的房门被人从外一脚踢开。
这声巨响，却是没有让少年的神色泛起任何波澜。
“罪子，既然醒了，就赶紧给我起来，你来这矿区是来赎罪的，不是来享福的，赶紧给我挖矿去，不然今日的口粮没收。”
门外出现了几道身影，几人看着床上的方羽眼中露出一丝不屑，其中一位壮汉看着方羽开口喝道。
“这废物，还以为自己是方家大少爷呢，来三天了居然还躺在这，方家被株连九族，他居然逃过了一劫，真是好狗运。”
“确实是走了狗运，听说国师亲自出面，向陛下求情，陛下才网开一面饶他一命。”
“不过就算是活下来又有什么用，如今来到这十万大山，他就能够活下来吗？方家勾结妖族，死不足惜，这废物有何脸面苟活于世。”
几人看着床上的方羽，纷纷一脸厌恶的开口说道。
就在此时，原本一动不动的方羽，眼睑微微一颤，双手不由微微一握，那原本无神的双目，骤然出现了一丝神采。
随后在几人的目光下，方羽艰难的坐立了起来。
“看来还没废，赶紧进入矿坑，你已经三天没有交工了，新来的第一个月每天二十块青灵石，你三天上缴份额，三天就是六十块，加上今日就是八十块，今日若是无法交上，口粮减半，明日若是还无法交齐，在今日的基础上继续减半。”
那为首的壮汉看着方羽冷漠的开口说道。

Chapter 1 Sin Son
During the Daxia Dynasty, at the foot of Qingyuan Mountain on Jiangnan Road.
It was the beginning of winter, the mountains were covered with heavy snow, and the ground was covered with white snow. However, the snow at this time was not white, but dyed red with blood.
In the flying snow, a young man was lying on the ground, and another voluptuous woman stood in front of him, holding a sword in his right hand, and the white jade hand of his left hand, with the palm upward, a blood flame suspended in his palm, and five-color light flowing between the blood flames.
"Why?"
The figure lying on the ground raised his head with difficulty and asked.
"Bang."
The figure in front of him raised his foot and stepped on the young man's head.
"Why? Hahaha, Fang Yu, don't you understand now? From the moment I stepped into the Fang family, I just wanted revenge. If it weren't for Fang Xuanjing, my father would not have died. After ten years of hard work and hard work, I finally got the chance. It's just a pity. I couldn't take off the dog head of Fang Xuan Realm with my own hands; but it doesn't matter, my dear brother, you are my unexpected harvest. I didn't expect you to possess the Five Elements Burning Sky Flame. With this Five Elements Burning Sky Flame, I can become an alchemist that thousands of warriors look up to."
The woman looked at Fang Yu at her feet and spoke with a ferocious face. Her words were full of madness, and her beautiful face was full of insidiousness.
After listening to Qin Yao's words, Fang Yu's body trembled violently, veins popped up on his forehead, his eyes were blood red, and traces of blood and tears flowed from his eyes.
"You're angry, but you're a loser, so you'd better restrain your incompetent anger. I'm curious, when did you get involved with her and actually asked her to come forward to plead with Emperor Xia."
Qin Yao looked at Fang Yu at her feet, looking at the blood and tears on her cheeks, and couldn't help but chuckle and said.
"Search him for me. Although Fang Yu is a criminal, your Majesty has promised to spare his life and send him to Huangzhou. If we don't take him to Huangzhou, we will be the ones whose heads fall to the ground."
At this moment, a sharp shout came from the distance.
Qin Yao frowned when she heard the sharp shouts in the distance, and then looked at Fang Yu at her feet.
"Brother, my sister is gone. I hope you can survive in Shiwandashan."
Qin Yao leaned down, reached out and patted Fang Yu's cheek, and said with a slight smile.
Qin Yao looked at Fang Yu who was like mud, smiled coldly, then stood up, took a step forward, and reappeared already a foot away, then turned into afterimages and flew away into the distance.
...
There are hundreds of thousands of mountains in the deserted state.
In a dilapidated hut, a young man was lying on the broken wooden bed. The young man's face was gray and his eyes were looking at the beams above.
"Bang."
At this moment, a roar came, and then the broken door was kicked open from the outside.
This loud noise did not cause any disturbance in the young man's expression.
"Son of sin, since you're awake, get up quickly. You came to this mining area to atone for your sins, not to enjoy the blessings. Hurry up and dig for me, otherwise today's rations will be confiscated."
Several figures appeared outside the door. They looked at Fang Yu on the bed with a trace of disdain in their eyes. One of them, a strong man, looked at Fang Yu and shouted.
"This trash, he thought he was the eldest young master of the Fang family, and he is still lying here three days after he came. The Fang family was implicated in the nine clans, and he actually escaped. It's really good luck."
"It was really bad luck. I heard that the Imperial Master personally came forward to plead with His Majesty, and His Majesty spared his life."
"But even if he survives, what's the use? Now that he's here in the Hundred Thousand Mountains, will he be able to survive? The Fang family has colluded with the demon clan and it's not a pity to die. How can this loser have the face to live in the world."
...
Several people looked at Fang Yu on the bed and spoke with disgust.
At this moment, Fang Yu, who was originally motionless, his eyelids trembled slightly, his hands couldn't help but clenched slightly, and his eyes that were originally dull suddenly showed a trace of brightness.
Then under the gazes of several people, Fang Yu sat up with difficulty.
"It doesn't look like it's broken yet. Hurry up and enter the mine. You haven't turned in work for three days. In the first month of your new life, you will pay twenty pieces of blue spirit stone every day. If you turn in your share in three days, it will be sixty yuan in three days. If you add today, it will be eighty yuan. If you can't pay it in today, your rations will be halved. If you still can't pay it in full tomorrow, it will be halved on the basis of today."
The strong man at the head looked at Fang Yu and said coldly.
